full_prompt_en: A square decorative fantasy illustration shows a pale black-haired figure with broad dark wings beside a large white bird in a densely patterned setting. The background is a gray and charcoal mosaic of tiny strokes, scattered rust-red leaves and curling pale branches, with little conventional horizon. On the left, the figure sits or crouches with knees drawn up, their head turned toward the right. Short black hair frames a pale face whose fine features are outlined in black; the expression appears quiet and intent. A voluminous purple-black cloak folds around the body and extends outward into winglike layers, each layer veined with delicate colored lines and close decorative marks. Across the upper-right and center, the white bird sweeps to the right, its long open wings described feather by feather in cream-gray ink. Its body overlaps the figure's dark shape, making the bright plumage the central contrast. Near the lower edge, narrow bands of red, cream and charcoal pattern resemble a worn ornamental floor or border, while scattered small objects and leaves fill the remaining gaps. Fine black contours and intricate hatching make every surface active, but the largest dark and white masses remain clearly separated. Light is diffuse and slightly cool, catching the pale face and feathers against the deeper cloak and ground; there is no hard cast shadow. The overall composition balances a poised shadowed figure with a broad luminous wing, creating an ornate, still moment charged by implied movement.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形装饰性奇幻插画里，一位浅肤黑发人物展开宽阔暗翼，旁边是一只大白鸟，背景花纹密布。灰与炭色底由细小笔痕、散落锈红叶片和卷曲浅枝拼成，几乎没有普通地平线。左侧人物坐着或蹲着，双膝收起，头转向右。短黑发围住浅色面孔，细致五官由黑线描出，神情安静而专注。宽大的紫黑斗篷绕着身体折起，并向外展开成翼状层片，每层布满纤细彩线脉络和密集装饰笔痕。右上和中央，一只白鸟向右掠过，长长张开的翅膀以奶油灰墨线逐羽描写。鸟身盖过人物暗形，使明亮羽毛成为中央对照。下缘，红、奶油与炭色的窄花纹带像磨旧装饰地面或边框，散落的小物和叶片填满余隙。细黑轮廓与精密排线让每处表面活跃，但最大暗块和白块仍清楚分开。光漫射而略冷，让浅色脸和羽毛在更深的斗篷、底纹前受光；没有硬投影。整体构图让端坐阴影中的人物与宽阔发亮的翅膀平衡，形成精致、静止却暗含运动的一刻。
style_prompt_en: The decorative illustration layers extremely fine ink outlines, dense hatchwork and muted jewel-color threads over a speckled, tapestry-like ground. Deep violet, charcoal and rusty red masses contrast with large cream-white areas, establishing clear hierarchy within elaborate detail. Edges stay precise around focal silhouettes, while smaller motifs braid together into a continuous ornamental field. Illumination is diffuse and cool; brightness comes from pale color and fine linework rather than glossy highlights. Curving diagonals sweep through a compact composition, making still forms feel lightly animated. The result is intricate, antique and slightly uncanny, with pattern and silhouette working at equal strength.
style_prompt_zh: 这种装饰插画在点状织毯式底上叠加极细墨轮廓、密排线和压低的宝石色丝线。深紫、炭色与锈红量块对照大片奶油白，在繁复细节中建立清楚层级。焦点剪影周围边缘精确，小纹样则编织成连续装饰场。光漫射而冷，亮度主要来自浅色和细线，而非光滑高光。弯曲斜线扫过紧凑构图，让静止形体也似微微活动。成品繁密、古旧而略带怪异，纹样和剪影具有同等力量。
theme_en: A dark-winged figure beside a white bird amid a dense patterned field
theme_zh: 暗翼人物与白鸟并置于繁密花纹背景前
name: Harry Clarke
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
